cells.quote: After the pilot study*, the control group has still a higher average value (111.63), however, the gap between the two groups has reduced from an average of 31.86 to 21.45.
cells.note: The post-pilot control-group average remained higher, but the study does not report a significance test for the post-pilot difference.
The reported strategy differences favor different groups depending on the strategy.

cells.quote: Before the study**, the control group reached an average of 92.63 points, whereas the experimental group scored 60.77. The control group performed significantly ( p = .001) better than the experimental group.
cells.note: This is a significant baseline group difference, not evidence of a podcast treatment effect.

D.treatment: seven-week module with YouTube-integrated reading instruction

O.outcome_detail: Vocabulary Knowledge Scale recognition and understanding, assessed one week after the treatment

cells.quote: The results show that there was a significant improvement ( t (99)  = -17.021, p < 0.05) in vocabulary recognition and understanding among the students when comparing the scores of the students on the tests carried out before (M= 22.8, SD= 7.7) and after (M= 42.7, SD= 10.9) the lessons were conducted.
cells.note: The paired analysis pooled the experimental and control groups, so it estimates pre-post improvement across the full sample rather than the unique effect of YouTube.
